tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Step 1. Quote Monero (XMR) <-> native USDC on Arbitrum One; no KYC, account or API key. Read-only; quotes are estimates. Buy XMR ("get me 1 XMR"): {direction:"u2x", receiveAmount:"1"}. Sell XMR: {direction:"x2u", amount:"0.5"}. direction plus exactly one of amount (what the user sends) or receiveAmo

tools.name: create_swap
tools.description: Step 2. Creates the order from get_quote's next.arguments (quoteId, plus to if the quote had none): one order per quote; moves no funds. Retry with the same arguments: the default idempotencyKey returns the same order. Fund once, only while payable is true: before signing deposit.payment, get_swap_s

tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.description: Step 3. waiting_for_funding -> deposit_detected -> swap_processing -> completed, or refunding / terminal_failure (outcome refunded, failed, expired). Long-poll with waitSec 25 and sinceState = the last state; repeat next until terminal. deposit.payment may be used only while payable is true. Call it

tools.name: get_funding_options
tools.description: Offline. How to get what the user sends: native USDC (not USDC.e) plus a little ETH for gas on Arbitrum One (u2x, default), or XMR in their own wallet (x2u). Pass from {chain, asset} (and amount) for one ordered checklist: quote, fund, re-quote (requoteOf).

tools.name: list_swaps
tools.description: Find orders when the orderId is lost (new chat, crash, unknown create outcome): pass the idempotencyKey create_swap used (default q_<quoteId>), or a sessionId. Read-only; addresses redacted; states can lag. Next: get_swap_status (live state, payable).

tools.name: plan_swap
tools.description: Optional, offline. Checks a partial request (direction, amount or receiveAmount, to) and returns the next question for the user. Skip it when you have what get_quote needs.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Optional. Chains, limits (provider minimum, USD), quote window, idempotency, validation rules, polling and the flow.

tools.name: create_support_ticket
tools.description: For a failed or stuck swap: orderId and what happened; never seed phrases or private keys. Returns ticketId; no tool reads replies (follow up at support@xmrtousdc.xyz).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_support_ticket" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
